# LAMMPS input script for quenching sodium silicate

units real
atom_style charge
boundary p p p

# Read data file

# Define settings
neighbor 2.0 bin
neigh_modify delay 0 every 1 check yes

# Define thermo output

thermo_style custom step temp press density

# Run quenching
run 370000

# Equilibrate at 300 K
unfix 1

run 10000

# End of script
